done_when: The hand-back reverts only the worker's own forge.toml edits, keeps settings that came from merging the default branch, and a test with a round that merges main's changed settings keeps them, on new and adopted repos
why: When a build round merges main after main's forge.toml changed, the hand-back treats main's new settings as the worker's edit and restores the round's old copy, so merging the fix reverts main's settings
